question: Determine which three lowest-level Reactome pathways (with TAS evidence) have the highest chi-squared statistics, considering only Homo sapiens targets associated with sorafenib under the conditions that the median assay value is ≤ 100 and both low and high assay values are ≤ 100 or null. For each of these three pathways, how many of these targets and non-targets lie within the pathway and outside it?
sql:
-- Final result: Top 3 pathways with all required columns
WITH filtered_targets AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT i.target_uniprotID
    FROM `isb-cgc-bq.targetome_versioned.interactions_v1` i
    JOIN `isb-cgc-bq.targetome_versioned.experiments_v1` e ON i.expID = e.expID
    WHERE i.drugID = 157 
      AND i.targetSpecies = 'Homo sapiens'
      AND e.exp_assayValueMedian <= 100
      AND (e.exp_assayValueLow <= 100 OR e.exp_assayValueLow IS NULL)
      AND (e.exp_assayValueHigh <= 100 OR e.exp_assayValueHigh IS NULL)
),
all_pe_with_tas AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT pe.stable_id, pe.uniprot_id
    FROM `isb-cgc-bq.reactome_versioned.physical_entity_v77` pe
    JOIN `isb-cgc-bq.reactome_versioned.pe_to_pathway_v77` ppe ON pe.stable_id = ppe.pe_stable_id
    JOIN `isb-cgc-bq.reactome_versioned.pathway_v77` p ON ppe.pathway_stable_id = p.stable_id
    WHERE ppe.evidence_code = 'TAS'
      AND p.lowest_level = TRUE
      AND p.species = 'Homo sapiens'
),
target_pe AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT ap.stable_id
    FROM all_pe_with_tas ap
    WHERE ap.uniprot_id IN (SELECT target_uniprotID FROM filtered_targets)
),
non_target_pe AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT ap.stable_id
    FROM all_pe_with_tas ap
    WHERE ap.stable_id NOT IN (SELECT stable_id FROM target_pe)
),
pathway_pe_map AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT ppe.pathway_stable_id, ppe.pe_stable_id
    FROM `isb-cgc-bq.reactome_versioned.pe_to_pathway_v77` ppe
    JOIN `isb-cgc-bq.reactome_versioned.pathway_v77` p ON ppe.pathway_stable_id = p.stable_id
    WHERE ppe.evidence_code = 'TAS'
      AND p.lowest_level = TRUE
      AND p.species = 'Homo sapiens'
),
pathway_counts AS (
    SELECT 
        ppe.pathway_stable_id,
        p.name as pathway_name,
        COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN tp.stable_id IS NOT NULL THEN tp.stable_id END) as targets_in,
        COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN ntp.stable_id IS NOT NULL THEN ntp.stable_id END) as non_targets_in
    FROM pathway_pe_map ppe
    JOIN `isb-cgc-bq.reactome_versioned.pathway_v77` p ON ppe.pathway_stable_id = p.stable_id
    LEFT JOIN target_pe tp ON tp.stable_id = ppe.pe_stable_id
    LEFT JOIN non_target_pe ntp ON ntp.stable_id = ppe.pe_stable_id
    GROUP BY ppe.pathway_stable_id, p.name
),
totals AS (
    SELECT 
        (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT stable_id) FROM target_pe) as total_targets,
        (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT stable_id) FROM non_target_pe) as total_non_targets
)
SELECT 
    pc.pathway_stable_id,
    pc.pathway_name,
    ROUND(SAFE_DIVIDE(
        (t.total_targets + t.total_non_targets) * 
        POW(
            (pc.targets_in * (t.total_non_targets - pc.non_targets_in) - 
             (t.total_targets - pc.targets_in) * pc.non_targets_in), 2
        ),
        (pc.targets_in + (t.total_targets - pc.targets_in)) *
        ((t.total_non_targets - pc.non_targets_in) + pc.non_targets_in) *
        (pc.targets_in + pc.non_targets_in) *
        ((t.total_targets - pc.targets_in) + (t.total_non_targets - pc.non_targets_in))
    ), 4) as chi_squared,
    pc.targets_in as targets_within,
    t.total_targets - pc.targets_in as targets_outside,
    pc.non_targets_in as non_targets_within,
    t.total_non_targets - pc.non_targets_in as non_targets_outside
FROM pathway_counts pc
CROSS JOIN totals t
WHERE pc.targets_in > 0
ORDER BY chi_squared DESC
LIMIT 3
